create_mturk_agent: create an MTurkAgent instance for a worker assigned to a specific MTurk unit
approve_mturk_work: approve the work submitted by an MTurk agent with an optional bonus and review note
reject_mturk_work: reject the work submitted by an MTurk agent with an optional review note
reconcile_mturk_data: reconcile submitted MTurk assignment data directly from MTurk when data was missed
mark_mturk_agent_done: mark an MTurk agent as done and update its status to completed in the database
